name: openclaw-node memory
description: Context engine backed by the openclaw-node memory daemon: per-turn recall from the loopback inject server (:7893), extraction left to the daemon's transcript watcher.

injectUrl.label: Inject server URL
injectUrl.help: The memory daemon's loopback inject server. Must be loopback; the daemon refuses anything else.

tokenPath.label: Token file
tokenPath.help: Bearer token the daemon writes on first start (0600). Re-read on every request so a rotated token is picked up without a restart.

autoRecall.label: Auto-recall
autoRecall.help: Inject the [memory: …] block into the system prompt on every turn (default true).

timeoutMs.label: Request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: The daemon answers in well under a second when warm; on timeout the turn proceeds without memory.

bypassSessionPatterns.label: Bypass session patterns
bypassSessionPatterns.help: Session keys that never get recall. * within one segment, ** across segments.
